newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Malan signs decree for bank-watching body.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Malan signs decree for bank-watching body.

text.p: Brazil's Finance Minister Pedro Malan has signed a decree allowing for the creation of two new bodies within the federal tax office to monitor financial institutions and international affairs, a spokesman said.
"The decree should appear in the government's official gazette tomorrow," the ministry spokesman said.
"These will be divisions within the federal tax office. They will be created using people who are already carrying out these functions, only they will be doing them more closely," the spokesman said.

The creation of the Special Financial Institutions Force comes at a time when a parliamentary committee is examining a multi-million dollar municipal bond scam which has already resulted in the closure of more than a dozen small banks and pension funds.
However the idea to create a new body has been under study for more than a year and is not a result of the current probe, the spokesman said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
